item.title: Federal Judge Rules Against ICE Over Memo That Expanded Power To Make Warrantless Arrests
item.description: Francia Garcia Hernandez/Block Club ChicagoU.S. District Judge Jeffrey Cummings ruled that immigration agents must follow the Castañon Nava consent decree, which is still in effect.

item.title: Meet the Chicago Students on the Frontlines of Walkouts
item.description: Max Herman/Borderless MagazineThe walkout is part of a series of student protests across Chicago amid a surge in immigration enforcement under President Donald Trump.

item.title: Mexican Father Who Signed for Voluntary Departure Didn’t Know He Had a Chance to Stay
item.description: Camilla Forte/Borderless Magazine/Catchlight Local/Report for AmericaVoluntary departures have skyrocketed under Trump, leading some attorneys to question whether immigrants are being coerced into agreeing to the alternative to deportation.

item.title: Illinois Man Whose Father Was Detained Attends Trump’s State of the Union
item.description: Kenny Holston/Pool via CNP/Sipa USA/Alamy Live NewsJaime Jr.’s father was arrested and taken to Mexico during Operation Midway Blitz in Chicago, leaving him to care for his teenage siblings.

item.title: Illinois Families, Child Care Providers on Edge Following Trump Funding Freeze
item.description: Photo illustration by Max Herman/Borderless Magazine. Source images: Zoonar/Morozova Tatiana/Alamy and State of IllinoisWhile the funds have not been permanently cut, advocates say the impact is threatening Illinois families, creating uncertainty for the future of some immigrant-run child care facilities.

item.title: A Soccer Stadium Is Coming to Chinatown’s Doorstep. Locals Want Guarantees It Won’t Push Them Out.
item.description: Camilla Forte/Borderless Magazine/Catchlight Local/Report for AmericaWhile the amount of tax subsidies for the stadium remains undecided, community members are pushing for a formal agreement to secure the development's promised affordable housing and economic benefits.

item.title: ‘We Have Each Other’s Backs’: An Environmental Organizer Sets His Sights on ICE
item.description: Camilla Forte/Borderless Magazine/Catchlight Local/Report for AmericaDavid Barboza has spent years fighting pollution on the Southeast Side of Chicago. But when Donald Trump was re-elected in 2025, he saw a new threat to his community: immigrant deportations.

item.title: ‘We Can’t Live in Fear’: How a Cafe Owner Showed up for Community and Himself
item.description: Camilla Forte/Borderless Magazine/Catchlight Local/Report for AmericaWhen Operation Midway Blitz put a target on Latino-owned businesses, Ozzy Gámez refused to stay at home.

item.title: How to Vote in Illinois this Primary Election
item.description: Camilla Forte/Borderless Magazine/Catchlight Local/Report for AmericaHere's what Illinois voters and non-English speakers need to know when casting their ballot in Illinois on March 17.

item.title: How Trump’s Immigration Policy is Influencing Chicago Voters This Primary
item.description: Photo collage by Max Herman. Photos by Camilla Forte/Borderless Magazine/Catchlight Local/Report for AmericaVoters shared concerns about immigration policy, heightened immigration detention and aggressive enforcement tactics in the Illinois primary election on March 17.
